Packet(0) = DC		-> Constant?
Packet(1..4) AETR	-> 1,2 unused always 80
Packet(3) Throttle	-> F7..80..0F
Packet(4) Steering	-> 1F..80..E7
Packet(5) GY Trim	-> 02..3D
Packet(6) = 20		-> Constant?
Packet(7) TH Trim	-> 02..3D
Packet(8) ST Trim	-> ?..20..?
Packet(9) = 89		-> Changes on each TX start? different value on each channel
Packet(10)= 0C		-> Constant?
Packet(11)= 0		-> Constant?
Packet(12)= 0		-> Constant?
